Marta (People Ops): :wave: New programs live today: Compassionate Travel Advance (one-time) and Backup-Care Credit pilot. Short note below and links to form/FAQ.

Diego (People Ops): TL;DR: Compassionate Travel Advance up to $2,000 for urgent family, medical, or legal travel (includes documentation translation/expedite fees and pet repatriation when relevant). Backup-Care Credit: $500 annual credit for last-minute licensed care. Both are opt-in and intended for time-sensitive needs.

Rae (Eng): Pet repatriation covered? That's unexpectedly helpful.

Marta (People Ops): Yes, when pet travel is directly tied to an emergency relocation or medical repatriation of a family member. Attach the vet/agency confirmation to the form.

Nina (Finance): Processing notes: advances < $2k coded to "Compassionate Travel Advance". Repayment options: payroll spread over up to 3 pay cycles, immediate card debit, or manager-approved conversion to a grant for extreme hardship. If you pick payroll, include preferred start paycheck in the form.

Liam (Security): For international medical evacuations we may need to coordinate with Security. If you tag "evacuation" in the form, Security will route to the right channel for assistance.

Rae (Eng): How fast are approvals?

Diego (People Ops): We have an expedited queue for documented emergencies. Submit before 4:00pm PT and People Ops + Finance aim for same-day review. After-hours submissions will be triaged next business morning unless its clearly time-critical; in that case tag @peopleops on Slack.

Marta (People Ops): Form: https://forms.redwood/compassionate-travel-advance  include one-line reason + attachments (itinerary, confirmation, medical/legal note, translation receipt). Use subject field "compassionate-advance" for priority.

Diego (People Ops): Backup-Care enrollment: https://forms.redwood/backup-care-pilot  one-click opt-in, regional tax note included in the FAQ. Pilot runs 6 months.

Nina (Finance): Quick tax note: the credit may be taxable in some jurisdictions; we'll flag that on enrollment and provide gross-up where company policy requires.

Rae (Eng): Any changes to offsite travel approvals?

Marta (People Ops): Minor process update: company-funded offsite attendees must accept a short Code of Conduct acknowledgement during travel preapproval. Weve added a checkbox to the travel form; RSVPs/expenses for company-funded events will be blocked until ack is recorded. If you need an alternative path for sincere objections or accessibility reasons, DM People Ops.

peopleops-bot: Notice set: "Offsite CoC ack" will ping attendees 7 days and 24 hours before departure.

Diego (People Ops): We'll host an AMA tomorrow 10:00am PT in #people-ops-ama to walk through edge cases (evacuations, pet repatriation, grant conversions). Bring examples if you want a private walkthrough.

Rae (Eng): Appreciate this. One ask: can Finance provide a sample repayment schedule?

Nina (Finance): Yes  I'll post a short spreadsheet template and example schedules in the FAQ doc after the AMA. Reply here if you'd like a one-on-one review.

Marta (People Ops): Thank you all  full policy, FAQ, and links: https://docs.redwood/internal/compassionate-travel-backupcare. If you need immediate help, DM People Ops or tag @peopleops on Slack.
